'''Jar Silvin''' is an old warhand under the command of [[Gareth Bryne]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is younger than most of Gareth's men, though old enough to have gray hair.

== Activities ==
He sets off with Gareth to track down [[Siuan Sanche]] when she skirts her oath to him. This leads him all the way from [[Andor]] to [[Salidar]] where the rebel [[Aes Sedai]] have set up camp.
